dex.entry: The Dawn Legendary — the kin that was always there, sleeping beneath Dawnstead in a sealed reliquary of sunrise-stone, waiting for the day that never came. It is not a new creature: it is the oldest kin in Vesperholm, the guardian of the first dawn, placed there by the original star-tenders as a fai

art.silhouette: A lion-stag — lion's body with a stag's great antlers — made of and wreathed in actual sunlight. The coat is amber-to-white radiance, the mane a full halo of solar corona arcs in diamond-cyan and fire-orange. The antlers are molten gold with sun-flare tips, casting hard shadows in every direction. Eyes are two full solar discs: white-hot centres with amber halos. In the post-game palette of true daylight colours, it reads as a creature from a different, brighter world — because it is.

art.direction: The reward for completing the journey. The moment Dawnbrael steps into real sunlight for the first time, the game earns everything it promised.
